items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Oh, no, I thought you said Charlie Christian.

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s not — I guess about a year, or a couple of years. I was supposed to do another one last month but he didn’t call me. But even there’s one after that I made with Jody Christian in Chicago. You ever heard of him? The piano player? Jody Christian?
Oh, no, I thought you said Charlie Christian.
No, Jody Christian. A very fine pianist.
